resources.string: Shows 10-bit HLG video as HDR on this screen. A monitor LUT or UC-Log keeps the normal (SDR) view.

Offers maker-specific modes such as sensor HDR where this phone advertises them, and 8K in direct mode (camera straight to the encoder: no LUT, no UC-Log, no proxy; the screen shows a reduced preview). Run the auto-configuration again after turning it on: only modes that held there are offered. They may not work, or may change with system updates.
